name: CASP15 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction
description: CASP15 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction evaluates methods for predicting 3D protein structures from sequence and related inputs. It is a community-wide blind assessment using experimentally determined targets released during the competition period.
evaluation_method: Predicted structures are compared against hidden experimental ground truth using structural similarity metrics such as GDT-like scores, lDDT, and related CASP-specific assessments.
notes: CASP is a blind, periodically updated community experiment rather than a fixed public question set; evaluation focuses on prediction quality for unseen targets.
